summary: Patrick County, Virginia: a wooden lookout built 1943, replaced by a 60-foot Aermotor in 1949; NHLR-registered 1994. Staffing and access not found.

notes_for_editor: Built, replacement, cabin, 1989 dedication and registration all agree across the NHLR page, the Forest Lookouts page and the Patrick County Chamber page. The Chamber text repeats the NHLR description, so it is not independent confirmation. No staffing or access source found. A Martinsville Bulletin article (martinsvillebulletin.com) returned HTTP 429 and was not read. The record's source_pages list nhlr.org/lookouts/us/va/blakey-ridge-fire-tower/, which appears to be a different site (Blakey Ridge, Madison County); it was not used and should be checked. No photos added: the NHLR page credits no image URL that I could find.
